body: This English version is a translation provided for convenience. If it differs from the Korean original, the Korean original prevails.
These Terms set out the rights, obligations and responsibilities between users and the Operator regarding the use of Nostra (the "App").

heading: Article 1 (Purpose)
body: The purpose of these Terms is to set out the matters necessary for users' use of the App.

heading: Article 2 (Services)
body: The App provides the following features.
bullets: Number generation for Lotto 6/45 and Pension Lottery 720+ (multiple methods)
Recording and storing generated numbers and purchased tickets (QR scan or manual entry)
Checking for wins against published draw data
Displaying the results of statistical tests of each method's performance
Looking up 1st- and 2nd-prize winning stores by draw
Rewarded ads — used to increase the number of daily draws

heading: Article 3 (Eligibility)
body: Anyone can use the App without signing up.
Only persons aged 19 or older may purchase lottery tickets, and the App does not sell lottery tickets or purchase them on anyone's behalf.

heading: Article 4 (Information for Reference Only)
body: All numbers and statistics provided by the App are for reference only and do not guarantee a win. Lotto and the Pension Lottery are random draws.
The App does not claim that any method is better than chance. On the contrary, the statistics screen shows as-is whether each method's results can be distinguished from chance.
The Operator is not responsible for any gains or losses arising from lottery purchases or their results. Please be careful about excessive purchasing and gambling addiction.

heading: Article 5 (Copyright and Rights)
bullets: Official draw data and winning store information are public materials of the lottery issuer.
The Operator holds the copyright in the App's design, code and text.
The App is not affiliated with the lottery issuer and does not use the issuer's trademarks or logos.

heading: Article 6 (User Obligations)
body: Users must not engage in the following acts.
bullets: Reverse-engineering or modifying the App and redistributing it
Obtaining rewards by automatically manipulating ads
Calling the public data the App reads in abnormally large volumes

heading: Article 7 (Service Suspension)
body: The Operator may suspend all or part of the service in the following cases.
bullets: Maintenance, system failures, or failures or policy changes at external data providers
Natural disasters, war or other force majeure events

body: Draw data may not always be updated on time. In that case, the App shows on screen that the data is delayed — if the data is out of date and no such notice is shown, please treat it as an error.

heading: Article 8 (Limitation of Liability)
bullets: The App operates based on data saved by users themselves and published draw data.
The Operator is not liable for damages arising in the course of using the free services, unless caused by the Operator's intent or gross negligence.
Results may differ due to response delays or errors at external data providers.

heading: Article 9 (Changes to These Terms)
body: If these Terms change, the Operator will update both the text on this screen and the effective date shown at the top, and will announce the change through an App update. Important changes will be announced 7 days before the effective date, and if you do not agree to the changed Terms, you may stop using the App.

heading: Article 10 (Dispute Resolution)
body: Disputes concerning these Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea, and the competent court is the court having jurisdiction over the Operator's address.

heading: Contact
body: Please send inquiries about these Terms to the email address below.
